::: proof
The time $t_q(\vx)$ solves $\surv(t_q(\vx) \mid \vx) = 1 - q$:

$$
\ba
1 - q &= \surv(t_q(\vx) \mid \vx)
&& \text{(definition of } t_q(\vx) \text{)} \\
&= \surv_0\paren{t_q(\vx) \cdot \hazfactor(\vx)}
&& \text{(AFT survival function)}
\ea
$$

Because $\surv_0$ is strictly decreasing,
$t_q^0$ is the only time at which $\surv_0$ equals $1 - q$, so:

$$
\ba
t_q(\vx) \cdot \hazfactor(\vx) &= t_q^0
&& \text{(} \surv_0 \text{ is one-to-one)} \\
t_q(\vx) &= \frac{t_q^0}{\hazfactor(\vx)}
&& \text{(divide by } \hazfactor(\vx) > 0 \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
